All pairs use the registered sameGPU2/head environment; representation, scaling, input dimension and trainable capacity remain bundled. Same device does not establish an isolated backbone or ensemble effect.

Criterion results are task/comparison-specific. All positive/negative/tie outcomes and new44/45 versus matched46/47 are retained; no pooled task/metric mean, official total, new cross-model contrast or posthoc winner ensemble.
Only existing native histories and max-epoch records are read. No new native stop/stress/group/ensemble/diagnostic metric, fixture replay or automatic epoch extension.
Prior CYP MiniTabM-vs-MiniMLP46/47 edges, when registered, are copied from the accepted32-edge table; old predictions/truth are never rescored.
